name: Dinotropolis Soft Play
addr: Dinotropolis, Upper Thames Walk, Bluewater Pkwy, Dartford, Greenhithe DA9 9SG
description: Dinotropolis at Bluewater is a dinosaur-themed soft play centre with three storeys of soft play in the Dino Jungle, the Raptor Run and a creative area called Discovery Cove. Entry for children aged 19 months and over is £17 (£16.50 booked online), babies aged 0 to 18 months are £3 online, and adults pay £7 (£6.50 online); all visitors, adults included, need a pass. Peak times are weekends, bank holidays and school holidays. Gold and Silver party packages are £35 and £28 per child, with a private party room and host. There are adult-only soft play sessions for ages 16 and over (£10 for two hours) on Thursday and Friday evenings and Saturday night, with photo ID required.
pricing_hint: Children 19 months+ £17 (£16.50 online); babies 0–18 months £3 online; adults £7 (£6.50 online)
party_info: Silver £28 and Gold £35 per party child guest, plus £6.50 per additional adult; includes a private party room and a dedicated host.

name: Kassiopi Cove Indoor Soft Play
description: Kassiopi Cove is a pirate-themed indoor soft play centre in Erith with fast slides, ball pits, swings and spinning interactive play. Children’s parties are offered with party packages; unofficial parties cannot bring in food, party bags or balloons. Prices and opening times are on the venue’s own website.

name: Cookie Island Ilford
addr: 3rd Floor, The Exchange Mall, High Rd, Ilford IG1 1RS
description: Cookie Island is a soft play centre on the third floor of The Exchange Mall in Ilford. Sessions last 90 minutes: Monday to Saturday at 9:30, 11:30, 1:30, 3:30 and 5:30, and Sunday at 11:30, 1:30 and 3:30. The website lists a café, parties, parent and toddler sessions and autism-friendly sessions; prices are on its booking page.

name: The Den at Fox & Kit
addr: 5-8 Holly Court, Midsomer Norton, Radstock BA3 2DB
description: The Den at Fox & Kit in Midsomer Norton is a spacious soft play area next to a parent-friendly café serving coffee, rolls, toasties and cakes. It is booked online, party information is on the website, and the venue says it is open six days a week until spring, including Sundays. Prices and ages are on the venue’s own website.

name: Brocksbushes Play Barn
description: The Play Barn at Brocksbushes Farm Shop, Stocksfield, has four levels of soft play and climbing for ages 0 to 11, including Little Brocks for under-4s, a 4-lane astra slide, trampolines, a climbing wall, cave crawls and role-play rooms. Children aged 1 to 11 pay £8.50 at peak times (weekends and school holidays) or £6.50 off-peak; 6 to 12 months £2.50; under-6-months free. One adult is free with each paying child and up to three more adults pay £2.50 each. Socks are required (£1.75 at the counter). A family café, free parking and birthday parties from £12.50 per child are offered.
pricing_hint: Children 1–11 £8.50 peak / £6.50 off-peak; 6–12 months £2.50; under 6 months free; one adult free per paying child
party_info: Birthday parties from £12.50 per child, with a private party area, food and drink package and dedicated host.

hours_override.text: Sessions: 9:30–11:30, 12:00–2:00 and 2:30–4:30 at peak times (weekends and school holidays); off-peak term-time weekday sessions are listed on the venue’s website.

name: Play Patch Community Soft Play
addr: The Hub, Fedden Buildings, Gainsborough Square, Lockleaze, Bristol BS7 9FB
description: Play Patch is a community soft play centre run by Lockleaze Neighbourhood Trust at The Hub, Gainsborough Square, Lockleaze, for families with children under five. Café sessions run Monday to Friday (9–11am, 11:30am–1:30pm and 2–4pm) and cost £2.50 per adult or child over five months when pre-booked (plus a 50p booking fee) or £3 walk-in; babes in arms are free. Birthday parties are £175 for exclusive use of the soft play, toys, café area and toilets, in weekend slots. The café serves home-cooked meals, hot drinks and treats.
pricing_hint: £2.50 per adult or child over 5 months when pre-booked (+50p fee); £3 walk-in; babes in arms free
party_info: £175 for exclusive use of the soft play, toys, café area and toilets; Saturday and Sunday slots of 1.5 hours party time plus set-up and clean-up.

hours_override.text: Café sessions Monday to Friday 9–11am, 11:30am–1:30pm and 2–4pm; party slots at weekends.

name: The Pod Soft Play at YMCA Hawker
addr: The Pod, Hawker Centre, Lower Ham Road, Kingston upon Thames KT2 5BH
description: The Pod is a two-storey soft play centre at YMCA Hawker, Lower Ham Road, Kingston, for children aged 11 and under, with a sensory room for under-2s and children with SEND. Entry is £7.50 per child including one accompanying adult, plus £2.50 for each additional adult; sessions are walk-in only, paid at reception, and last two hours (up to 1 hour 45 minutes when busy). A riverside café serves hot meals, drinks and snacks, and children’s parties are offered. Hours on the YMCA website: Monday to Wednesday 9am–5pm, Thursday (term time) 11:15am–5pm, Friday 9am–3pm (5pm if there is no party booking).
pricing_hint: £7.50 per child including one accompanying adult; additional adults £2.50
party_info: Parties are booked through the YMCA’s online booking account; party queries go to the Pod team.

hours_override.text: Monday to Wednesday 9am–5pm; Thursday (term time) 11:15am–5pm; Friday 9am–3pm (5pm if no party booking). Weekend hours are listed on the YMCA website.

name: Soft Play at Hilton Community Centre
addr: Hilton Village, Old Town Road, Inverness IV2 4HT
description: Hilton Community Centre in Inverness has a jungle-themed indoor soft play area for children aged 5 and under, open weekdays according to High Life Highland. Prices and session times are not published on the centre’s page; call the centre to check.

hours_override.text: Soft play open weekdays; session times not published online.

name: Soft Play at Musselburgh Sports Centre
description: Musselburgh Sports Centre has a soft play area for little ones, run by Enjoy Leisure, with soft play birthday parties available to book. Prices are on the centre’s price list and session times can change for private bookings, so check the Enjoy Leisure website before you go.

hours_override.text: Soft play times vary; check the centre’s website.

name: The Ark PlayCentre
description: The Ark PlayCentre in Cwmbran offers soft play sessions for children aged 0 to 6 on Tuesday to Friday, with two sessions a day; adults must be booked in for the children they bring, and adult entry is free. Food and drink from Victory Café can be enjoyed inside during sessions. Parties for up to 24 children with exclusive use can be booked in advance, and there is free parking. Session times and prices are on the venue’s website.

hours_override.text: Tuesday to Friday, two sessions a day; times on the venue’s website.

name: Discovery Village
description: Discovery Village in Christchurch is an indoor role play centre for ages 1 to 8, with nine themed role play areas including a vets, fire station, beauty salon and building site; it calls itself a calmer alternative to soft play. Two-hour play sessions are offered, with birthday party packages, a family café and free parking.

name: Thistles & Tykes
description: Thistles & Tykes in Renfrew is a role-play café and play centre for children aged 12 months to 5 years, built around Thistle Town, a miniature village with a theatre, vets, laundrette, supermarket and auto shop. Play sessions run daily at 9:15am, 11:15am and 1:15pm, each 1 hour 30 minutes, and the café serves coffee, cakes and snacks. Parties can be booked.

hours_override.text: Play sessions daily at 9:15am, 11:15am and 1:15pm (1 hour 30 minutes each).
